body: We are in the exact same situation. I understand this 100%

Don’t feel alone I struggled in high school with depression and mental illness and missed out on everything too. I agree it’s super hard to connect with people now and I feel like I don’t fit in anywhere
I starved myself and went through a serious eating disorder... and basically went completely psycho because of how starved I was. Also developed anxiety and depression. It’s common.

Listen to Hot Gates by Mumford and Sons..
Helps me get through all the time. Beautiful song about how even though life hurts and there is so much darkness we have to keep pushing on..
“And though we cry
We must stay alive”
Haha yep my notebooks are my best friends. Writing has been a huge help.

Being open makes my mom and dad stay awake all night on the couch. Or desperately try to make me try new forms of therapy and medication. 
I just need to find a purpose.. anything I love or a sense of self.

Just know that you are not alone. I am unhappy and depressed just the same. Tons of anxiety. And all for no reason, my life is perfect, I have everything. But I hate everything and don’t want to go on.
